name: Skyfall Charge
desc: Calls a blast down on the spot you aim at. It lands after 5s and kills whatever it catches, friend or foe, and wrecks revive beacons; then the ground burns for 3s: leave.
src: docs/SOURCE_UTILITIES.md: 5 s fuse, 5000 dmg / 7.2, then 720 dmg/s for 3 s (100/s here as 50 every 0.5 s); the blast hurts allies and you, and destroys beacons
